takethis.description_text:
Payments to Take This are made via the PayPal Giving Fund.

Take This is a mental health nonprofit serving the game community/industry that provides resources, guidelines and training about mental health issues in the game community, thus reducing the stigma of mental illness.

Take This provides gamers and developers with resources, guidelines, and training that help them support themselves and others in dealing with mental health challenges.

Take This’ key programs are its AFK Room Program at conventions, its mental health consulting program for game developers, and its ambassador program for streamers.

audiotrip.callout:
Dance Cardio in VR

89% Positive on Steam
audiotrip.description_text:
Audio Trip is a VR rhythm game where you dance to your favorite music (and workout in ‘Cardio’ levels) as you catch ‘gems’, ride ‘ribbons’, smash drums, & dodge barriers and MOVE YOUR BODY in 120 levels across 32 songs, plus support for your own songs and custom choreographies.

Express the dancer and fitness fanatic within you!

Make it YOUR “Audio Trip” by using the in-VR level editor to create custom choreographies with your own unique dance moves, with the same tool used by the developers to create their choreography!

Join our community to learn more and to showcase your flair! [Discord: https://audio.chat ]

Main Features:
  • Licensed music by top artists: Skrillex, Zedd, deadmau5, Lady Gaga, Tiësto, Psy... and more!
  • In-VR level editor (‘Choreographer’ tool) included.
  • BEGINNER, REGULAR, and EXPERT difficulties plus CARDIO levels for every song.
  • ‘Full Trip’ or ‘Short Trip’ options for each song.
  • Fully immersive and hand-crafted environments for each song.
  • Intuitive UI with a simple tutorial for your first time playing.
  • PLAYLISTS allow you to play through one of our lists of songs or create your own from any songs in the game, plus any of your own songs, for non-stop dance & workout regimes.
  • Gameplay customization: ‘Comfort’, ‘Dancer’, ‘No Fail’, custom colors, ‘Scenery Only mode’, and more.
  • Global and Local (Party Mode) Leaderboards to challenge your friends!
  • Campaign Mode with Achievements and Modifiers –Get rewarded with shiny badges while you progress through YOUR Audio Trip - And see them on display in the Dance Dojo!

    “Movement is a medicine for creating change in a person’s physical, emotional, and mental states.” – Carol Welch

    Choose your song & difficulty, then hit the LAUNCH button!

    Match your hands to the choreography, move to the music, and D A N C E

    Create your own choreography, or edit any of ours, with our in-VR editor!

    And don't forget to toggle on your virtual YUR watch to track your fitness and join in on the weekly Calories and Squats leaderboards while playing Audio Trip!

genotype.description_text:
In this Metroidvania FPS adventure, you explore an abandoned lab in Antarctica overrun by monstrous beasts. Print living creatures to use as weapons and survival tools, and take part in a fully voice-acted story as the facility’s sole survivor guides you through an alien ecosystem… but what role did he play in the research station’s downfall?

🔫 5 radically different weaponized creatures
💪 Diverse upgrade system giving you multiple play style options
🚧 Adrenaline-fueled combat spaces ready to test your mettle
👾 Unique enemies with fine-tuned behaviors and intense boss fights
🥵 Four difficulty settings
💰 Balanced loot amounts and ammo costs according to the chosen difficulty
🦾 Multiple accessibility options
📝 Fleshed out lore available to find within the facility
➕ Atmospheric synth-scapes, immersive voice acting, and much more

Morph into a tiny creature to go into narrow vents by using the Brainlink, or rip obstacles apart with the Grubber. The open world lets you move freely across interconnected maps. Open up new paths by unlocking new creatures to print or find new items.

Slay enemies, then upgrade your weaponized creatures and the gloves that wield them. When the alien ecosystem fights back, the weapon creatures you print with your gloves will determine your survival!

iamyourbeastvr.description_text:
I Am Your Beast VR brings Strange Scaffold’s shortform covert revenge thriller FPS into virtual reality, placing you inside Alphonse Harding’s one-man war against the military-industrial complex.

You are secret agent Alphonse Harding. Retired for six years, you’ve been asked to complete “one last job,” one too many times. Declining your latest mission sets in motion a furious guerilla war between you and the Covert Operations Initiative (COI) that litters the forest with bodies and bullet casings.

Grab their weapons. Throw them dry. Catch the next one. Duck, climb, strike, and vanish into your tunnel network before enemy forces zero in on your location. Repeat.



Features

  • Lightning-fast “he’s-in-the-walls” player fantasy, rebuilt for VR with hands-on gunplay, throwing, catching, climbing, and close-quarters chaos.

  • Fully voiced story campaign with 20+ levels.

  • Stylish comic book-inspired art direction built for fast reads and faster reactions.

  • Chase side objectives while shaving seconds off your best runs in replayable micro-sandboxes.

  • Wield pistols, sniper rifles, bear traps, and more using your own two hands.

  • Heart-slamming soundtrack from award-winning composer RJ Lake (Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator, Unbeatable, El Paso, Elsewhere).

  • Kinetic cutscenes and pulp-thriller attitude pulled directly into VR.

outofsightvr.description_text:
Sophie is blind, alone, and lost in a crumbling mansion. Her only hope? You, her beloved teddy bear. In Out of Sight VR, you’ll see the world through Teddy’s eyes and guide Sophie, navigating a world of creeping shadows and haunting secrets.

Flip the perspective and take control in a genre-defying second-person VR experience.

This groundbreaking second-person VR horror flips the script on traditional perspective. As Teddy, you’re Sophie’s only friend - and only lifeline. Strategically position yourself to scout dangers, uncover hidden paths, and lead Sophie away from the sinister figures hunting her every move.

Tension hangs on every breath, and each movement must be planned with care. One wrong step, one creak of the floorboards, and Sophie could be caught.

Face perspective-shifting chase sequences, solve second-perspective puzzles, and uncover the tragic history buried within the mansion’s walls. As fear builds and reality fractures, the line between protector and prisoner begins to blur.

Discover the haunting past hidden inside the walls and within Sophie herself.

Dripping with atmosphere and driven by emotional stakes, Out of Sight VR is more than your standard horror game. Every choice you make as Teddy could mean survival...or silence.

rager.description_text:
RAGER throws you into epic battles where you fight like a true warrior. Rhythm meets combat as each world tests your skill and dissolves once the battle is won. Every moment is powered by intense music that sharpens your senses and pulls you deeper into the fight.

"RAGER makes me feel like I'm engaging with an immersive fitness routine that's straight out of a movie." - UploadVR

"One of the best rhythm games! Colourful, powerful and sweaty!" - BENNiGaming

"RAGER is easily one of my favorite games to come out this year." - PatchS406

EPIC COMBAT

Campaign features 12 hand-built levels, including 3 epic boss fights, each with a preset weapon that challenges you to master different fighting styles.

Freestyle offers additional levels, all unlocked from the start, where weapon selection is on you.

WEAPONS

SWORD and MACE are one-handed weapons, each controlled independently through swing motions.

AXE and HAMMER are heavy two-handed weapons, controlled with both hands to deliver powerful, sweeping strikes.

CLAWS and FISTS are close-quarters weapons, each controlled separately with wild, feral motions built for aggressive, up-close combat.

KEY FEATURES

  • 180° and 360° Epic Combat

  • Boss Fights

  • Various Melee Weapons

  • Online Leaderboards

roboquestvr.description_text:
Strap In, Guardian: The Acclaimed Hyper-Speed Roguelite Explodes into VR!

The "Overwhelmingly Positive" rated flatscreen roguelite is here, specially rebuilt for VR, Roboquest VR delivers the fastest, most fluid, and deepest roguelite FPS in VR, period.

TOP FEATURES:

⚡ BLISTERING HYPER-MOBILITY

🔫 INSANE ARSENAL & TACTILE COMBAT

🛠️ DEEP ROGUELITE CUSTOMIZATION

♾️ ENDLESS CHAOS

💥 VIBRANT CEL-SHADED APOCALYPSE

🤝 2-PLAYER "BROBOT" CO-OP (COMING SOON)

The World is Broken. Time to Reboot It.

Step into the metallic boots of a rebooted Guardian and dive headfirst into a fast-paced, roguelite FPS experience like no other. With intuitive VR controls, you'll feel every shot, every dodge, and every exhilarating moment as you battle hordes of robots. Team up with a brobot and save the world!

Feel the most kinetic combat available in a headset as you sprint, slide, and grind across scorched canyons and futuristic cities.

Total Immersion: Physically weave through bullet hell, dodge incoming plasma fire with your own body, and return the favor with pinpoint precision.

Fluid, High-Octane Action: The movement is buttery-smooth, the combat is explosive, and the action never stops.

Unleash an Insane Arsenal

Your fingertips are the trigger. Every run is a new experiment in devastation.

Visceral Firepower: Feel the kick of high-powered shotguns, physically draw back a high-tension bow, or shred bots up close with razor-sharp melee weapons.

Master Your Tools: Utilize interactive weapon handling and manual reloading to stay in the fight. Mix and match your loadout and turn the robotic legion into molten slag.

The Chaos Never Repeats

Blast through levels that shift and evolve with dynamically generated enemy encounters. The bots adapt, and so must you. Discover hidden secrets, face down colossal bosses, and uncover the mysteries of a long-forgotten civilization.

Are you fast enough, Guardian?

survivingmars_pioneer.description_text:
Mars is calling—will you endure its unforgiving frontier?

The Red Planet is vast, desolate, and utterly indifferent to your survival. With nothing but your wits, limited resources, and the tools at your disposal, you must carve out an existence in one of the most hostile environments imaginable.

👩 🚀VR Survival Systems: Monitor essential survival stats like oxygen, nutrition, health, and power.

🚀 Resource and Crafting Systems: Establish and maintain production loops, crafting the tools and upgrades necessary to keep your operation running smoothly.

🌠Exploration and Traversal: Discover a compelling landscape with tools like jetpacks, hover bikes, and rovers. Seek out anomalies that will begin to reveal a story that unfolds throughout early access.

⛏️Dynamic Contracts: Fulfill mining and export tasks, earning resources, tech upgrades, and blueprints.

🏗️Base Building: Plan, position, and manage structures to expand your Martian outpost strategically.

For the first time, the Surviving Mars universe has been brought to VR, delivering a survival experience where every decision matters.

vracerhoverbike.description_text:
THE DEFINITIVE ARCADE RACER FOR VR

Race through neon cities, alien worlds, and orbital circuits. Lean into every turn using intuitive chest-based controls designed for comfort and immersion. Outrun missiles, drop mines, and blast your way to victory—this is VR racing at full throttle.

🏁 SEVEN GAME MODES

Solo, competitive, or chaotic—choose from Time Trial, Weekly Challenge, Combat, Survivor, Neon Runner, Multiplayer, and Career.

🌐 MULTIPLAYER & SOCIAL HUB

Race with up to 6 players in cross-platform online multiplayer. Choose your avatar and meet up in a social lobby between sessions.

 🌌 30 TRACKS ACROSS THE GALAXY

Race through highland valleys, desert colonies, neon-lit cities, and orbital spaceways. Each circuit offers unique challenges, visual styles, and hazards to master.

💥 COMBAT RACING

Use missiles, drones, EMPs, and more in fast-paced battles where every second counts.

🎨 LIVERY EDITOR & SHOWROOM

Design custom bikes, suits, and helmets in full VR.


🎨 TRACK EDITOR

Design custom tracks, play hundreds of them in all game modes, including multiplayer.


📸 PHOTO & REPLAY TOOLS

Pause time mid-race, fly through your replay, and capture your best moments from any angle

wrath_aeonofruinvr-brutaledition.description_text:
The Old World is rotting. Its Guardians have fallen. The corruption spreads.

You are the Outlander, pulled from the Ageless Sea and bound to a grim purpose by the Shepherd of Wayward Souls. Enter ancient ruins and dead forests. Tear through swarms that hunt in packs. Keep moving, keep firing, keep cutting, or the gloom takes you.

Brutal Edition is WRATH rebuilt and enhanced for VR, driven by a simple philosophy: deliver a more visceral experience. Expect enhanced dynamic movement, over-the-top combat, ramped-up bullet effects, and a helluva lot of blood. This edition also restores and refines the experience with wide-ranging improvements to combat feel, audio, effects, and overall polish. It’s the definitive way to play Wrath and you’re going to make a damn big mess doing it!

WRATH: Aeon of Ruin VR - Brutal Edition is built for speed and pressure. It is circle-strafing panic, close-range brutality, and constant decision-making. Which hand is clearing space? Which hand is landing the shot? When to slide, when to dash, when to throw an artifact and take the opening it creates.


Built for VR combat:

  • Dual-wielding at the core : Bring two weapons into the fight and run the battlefield your way.

  • Physical reloads and handling : Reload with a quick flick of the wrist and stay sharp when the pressure spikes.

  • Two-handed control rewards : Stabilize your weapon for better control, tighter spread, and access to alt-fire where available.

  • Blade dash, rebuilt for VR : Charge and launch with your blade for fast repositioning and advanced movement.

  • High-velocity slide : Keep momentum through tight spaces and turn movement into a weapon.


Artifacts you can feel

  • Physical artifacts with unique interactions : Select an artifact and use it like an object, not a button prompt.

  • Throw, break, deploy : Bring dark tools into the fight and use them under fire.


A world made of dread and secrets

  • Non-linear levels stuffed with hidden routes : Explore crypts, sunken ruins, corrupted temples, and cursed wilds.

  • Old-school structure, modern VR flow : Big spaces, brutal fights, constant tension.

  • In-Run Difficulty options : Tune damage values on the fly without stripping the world bare.
